scripts.test:report: npm run ensure-reports-dir && npx @cucumber/cucumber && node tests/support/generate-report.js && npx http-server ./reports -o /custom-report.html
scripts.clean:screenshots: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const reportsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'reports'); if (fs.existsSync(reportsDir)) { fs.readdirSync(reportsDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.png')).forEach(f => fs.unlinkSync(path.join(reportsDir, f))); }"
scripts.ensure-reports-dir: if not exist reports mkdir reports
scripts.report:full: npm run report:generate && npm run report:view
scripts.report:sample: npm run report:generate && node tests/support/inject-sample-data.js && node tests/support/update-cucumber-report.js && npm run report:view
